title: Cantagallo
lesson: Introduce una regla ética: una historia urbana no justifica fotografiar una comunidad vulnerable sin colaboración.
delta_vs_previous: No canonical change; historical additions remain provenance-only.
open_questions: Which current, primary place source verifies any derived Lima scene?
What field evidence would make the relationship legible in one frame?
expert_rejection: A published source can support a conceptual lens, but it cannot verify current scene conditions, access, safety, consent, light, activity, or one-frame strength. Cantagallo cannot become an extractive photo opportunity without collaboration and consent.
